title: Common Errors
markdown:
| Message or symptom | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| `read access violation. p was nullptr.` | following a null pointer | check before dereferencing; find out why it was null | 1.05 |
| Access violation at a small address such as `0x18` | `p->member` with `p` null; 0x18 is the member's offset | as above | 1.05 |
| Access violation at `0xCCCCCCCC...` | an uninitialised pointer | initialise every pointer | 1.05 |
| Access violation at `0xDDDDDDDD...` | a pointer read out of an object already deleted | fix the owner's lifetime; use a handle or `weak_ptr` | 1.05, 6.05 |
| `cannot convert from 'double *' to 'int *'` | pointer types do not match | point at the right type; casts only for byte views | 1.02 |
| `C4172: returning address of local variable` | returning `&local` | return the value, or memory that outlives the call | 4.02 |
| `sizeof` gives 8 inside a function | the array decayed to a pointer | pass the count, or a `std::span` | 2.01 |
| `Run-Time Check Failure #2 - Stack around the variable was corrupted` | writing past a local array | fix the bounds; use `std::array` and `at()` | 2.01, 4.02 |
| Image is drawn slanted | width used where the stride belongs | address rows with the stride | 2.04 |
| Value read through a cast pointer is wrong only in Release | strict aliasing violation | `std::memcpy` or `std::bit_cast` | 2.05 |
| `HEAP CORRUPTION DETECTED` | writing past a heap block | find the overrun with AddressSanitizer or page heap | 4.03, 6.05 |
| Crash inside `ntdll.dll` during `new` or `delete` | heap corruption, double free, or `delete` on a `new[]` array | match the pairs; run under ASan | 4.03 |
| `Detected memory leaks!` at exit | a heap object with no owner | `_CrtSetBreakAlloc(n)` to find it; then RAII | 4.05 |
| `attempting to reference a deleted function` when copying | copying a `unique_ptr` or a non-copyable RAII class | `std::move` it, or keep a borrowed pointer | 5.02 |
| Memory grows although everything is "smart" | a `shared_ptr` cycle | make the back-reference a `weak_ptr` | 5.03 |
| A `string_view` or `span` shows garbage | it outlived the string or vector it viewed | store an owning copy, or keep the owner alive | 5.04 |
| Crash after `push_back` | a pointer or view into the vector before it reallocated | keep an index instead | 1.05, 5.04 |
| Stack overflow (`0xC00000FD`) | deep recursion or a huge local array | use the heap or a loop with an explicit stack | 4.02 |
